title: 117 more OFWs return from Saudi Arabia amid Mideast tensions
summary: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 117 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Saudi Arabia returned to the Philippines through government-assisted voluntary repatriation amid continuing tensions…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A total of 117 overseas Filipino workers (OFWs) from Saudi Arabia returned to the Philippines through government-assisted voluntary repatriation amid continuing tensions in the Middle East.
